title: Global snapshots carry test-run counters and bounded session activity; complete run history is fetched on demand
outcome: GET /api/state and public SSE carry revision-consistent test-run counters and bounded per-session activity without a global run-summary array. All active, unresolved and historical canonical run identities remain reachable through filtered paged and exact-id reads, with existing evidence, waits and notification semantics preserved. No record or artifact is deleted; retention is a separate item.
acceptance: GET /api/state, initial/reconnect SSE snapshots and incremental public test-run updates carry revision-consistent test-run counters and the bounded activity data required by session badges and wait presentation, without a global list of historical, active or unresolved run summaries. Every active or unresolved run remains stored and reachable by filtered paged or exact-id reads; counts, uncertainty, owner/notify distinctions and notification/wait behavior are preserved. Regressions cover more than200 active/unresolved runs, terminal transitions, aliases and reconnect.

The existing paged GET /api/test-runs exposes complete canonical history including minimal retained compact identities, with filter-bound continuation and exact-id detail preserving verification associations. UI list/detail views fetch on demand, do not automatically drain history, reject stale responses, and preserve recorded-card fallback when detail is unavailable. No run record, artifact, proof or association is deleted by this change.

Record comparable before/after /api/state bytes and run counts with observed build/revision, separately report fixture measurements and available lock/projection measurements, and demonstrate that unrelated state publication does not rebuild/sort full test-run history under StateInner. The full gate passes on the exact committed input with a clean independent review pair.

completion.summary: Landed and running revision-consistent test-run counters with on-demand complete history; live Central state payload reduced49.48%, exact-tree FULLs/pair clean and landed native witness passed.
